meta.name: alterlab-ligandmpnn
meta.description: Design protein sequences around bound ligands, metals, and nucleic acids with LigandMPNN (Dauparas 2023) — inverse folding that conditions on non-protein context, so binding-pocket and metal-site residues are chosen to fit the actual ligand. Use when designing a small-molecule or metal binding pocket, redesigning residues that contact a ligand/ion/nucleic acid, or doing enzyme active-site design where the substrate matters. For backbone sequence design with NO ligand/metal context prefer alterlab-proteinmpnn; to GENERATE a backbone or scaffold a functional site prefer alterlab-rfdiffusion; to validate a design by refolding prefer alterlab-alphafold; to co-fold or dock the ligand prefer alterlab-boltz or alterlab-diffdock. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

copy.tagline: 设计能与配体、金属和核酸结合的蛋白质序列
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在设计小分子或金属结合蛋白，需要序列适配配体环境
copy.tagline_en: Design protein sequences that bind ligands, metals, and nucleic acids
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing small-molecule or metal-binding proteins and need sequences that fit the ligand environment

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据蛋白质结构中的配体、金属离子或核酸，设计出适合该结合位点的氨基酸序列。
howto.when: 当你想设计一个与配体或金属离子结合的蛋白质口袋，或改造与配体/离子/核酸接触的残基时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个结合锌离子的蛋白质口袋。
say.note: Claude 会读取含锌离子的结构并设计口袋序列。

say.text: 优化这个酶活性位点中与底物接触的残基。
say.note: Claude 会基于底物结构重新设计活性位点序列。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can design amino acid sequences for protein binding pockets that fit the actual ligand, metal ion, or nucleic acid present in the structure.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to design a small-molecule or metal binding pocket, or redesign residues contacting a ligand/ion/nucleic acid.

say_en.text: Design a protein pocket that binds a zinc ion.
say_en.note: Claude will read the structure with zinc and design the pocket sequence.

say_en.text: Optimize the active site residues that contact the substrate.
say_en.note: Claude will redesign the active site based on the substrate structure.
